title: Research and plan evidence-backed secondary insects
objective: Collect and structure direct quantitative evidence for 2–4 secondary insect species, preserve life-stage/source provenance, and produce a concrete implementation plan without changing the verified ant runtime.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate selection is based on direct target-species/life-stage evidence and explicit gaps
Large public datasets are indexed reproducibly without falsely claiming unmirrored bytes are bundled
No cross-species or cross-life-stage measurements are silently treated as direct calibration
A detailed implementation plan maps research into the existing profile, simulation, renderer, settings, performance, and validation architecture
Existing verified application source is not modified during the research-only task
